# R6.54a — REQ-XD-119 L1-on-L2 audit addendum (offline replay, $0 spend)

Executes the replay leg the frozen audit packet recorded as owed:
`audit.state: not_computed{o_recording_replay_not_executed}` →
`computed`. Fully offline and replay-only — the frozen H
(`sha256:c451ed97…`, the `2026-11-18-fp-ws1-l1-conformance` binary
set) drove `hh_l1_drive --mode obs_replay --mswea-pack` against a
local strict `hh-model-proxy` replay endpoint (`hh-l1-canon/1`,
sequence keying, first-divergence-fails). **Zero provider access,
zero metered spend** — the endpoint serves receipt-bound bytes only.

## What landed

- **`2026-11-19-fp-w4-l2-audit-addendum.json`** (`hh-fp-l2-audit/1`,
  sha `2c2da280…`) — `audit.state: computed`,
  `verdict: pass{5 sampled slots — 190/190 recorded calls
  verdict:exact}`, `amends` citing the frozen packet
  (`efbc4b8b…` — byte-untouched). The recorded L2 verdict is
  preserved; the frozen record and its sidecar stay append-only.
- **Per-slot typed results** — all five seeded W4 O slots pass:
  build-cython-ext-r1 22/22, largest-eigenval-r5 69/69,
  sanitize-git-repo-r5 21/21, gcode-to-text-r4 60/60,
  write-compressor-r3 18/18. Terminals: three typed
  `replay_exhausted{…client_gone boundary}` + two
  `completed{succeeded/scored}`. No first-divergence rows.
- **Each leg cites six retained evidence files + sha256s**
  (`~/hh-retained/w4/harvest/l1-audit/legs/<slot>/`: instruction,
  rebuilt raws, recording, replay-decl, proxy WAL, drive events)
  plus the H `run_id`; the manifest gains `audit_legs=` so the fold

- **Guards** — the emitter re-derives the seeded sample, enforces

  coverage (`LegOutsideSample`/`SampleMissingLeg` refusals), and

  exactly that on a real mid-run divergence (containment-denied
